recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is recommended unless Patient Care later changes Goal.target repetition or multi-target interpretation.
issue_request: FHIR-17572 asked how to represent a blood pressure goal with systolic and diastolic target values. The final Patient Care resolution made Goal.target 0..* and added requirements/commentary explaining that repeated targets support Observation components such as blood pressure and that all targets on one Goal must be met for the overall Goal to be met.
initial_application: The Jira comment links commit ef05a01a0bea, which changed source/goal/goal-spreadsheet.xml Goal.target from 0..1 to 0..*, added the blood-pressure requirements text, added the all-targets-must-be-met comment, and tagged the element with GF#17572. Later source refactoring preserved the same content in source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists goal=Goal as an active resource. Current source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml has the GF#17572 committee note, min 0, max *, the requested blood-pressure requirements sentence, and the requested comment. Related FHIR-17753 was applied in the same historical commit but concerns Goal.target.detail data types, not Goal.target cardinality or multi-target semantics. Searches did not find a later reversal.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build source already matches the FHIR-17572 resolution.
